primaryOutcome.summary: The Flow Contract and work-item baseline were written and both validated on the first attempt.

observations.observation: The only available flow-contract example (examples\handoff\demo-line-drawer\flow-contract.json) is schemaVersion 4 and still carries removed fields (status, approval, targetArchitecture.status, includedPaths/excludedPaths), while this run had to write schemaVersion 6, which forbids all of those and requires renderedSurfaceInventory/targetArchitecture/decisions/characterizationRequired that the example does not model at all. Copying the example's shape as instructed would have produced a contract the validator was certain to reject, so both schemas/flow-contract.schema.json and schemas/work-item-handoff.schema.json were read directly (three view calls each) to learn the current required properties before writing.
evidence: examples\handoff\demo-line-drawer\flow-contract.json declares "schemaVersion": 4 and includes "status", "approval" and "includedPaths"/"excludedPaths", none of which schemaVersion 6 permits.
schemas\flow-contract.schema.json required[] lists renderedSurfaceInventory-adjacent fields (targetArchitecture, decisions, characterizationRequired) that have no counterpart in the example file.
skillLocations: SKILL.md reading discipline: "Do not read schemas\ or scripts\ source to learn an artifact's shape. Copy the shape from examples\handoff\..."
SKILL.md workflow step 9: "Copy each block's shape from examples\handoff\ before writing it."
